mapper.update: UPDATE USER_LOGIN SET PARTY_ID = NULL WHERE PARTY_ID IN ( SELECT PARTY_ID FROM PARTY WHERE PARTY_TYPE_ID = 'PERSON' AND STATUS_ID = 'PARTY_DISABLED' AND END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND END_DATE < #{expirationDate} AND PARTY_NAME <> PARTY_ID )
mapper.select:
SELECT UL.*, ,
FROM USER_LOGIN UL INNER JOIN PARTY P ON UL.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID INNER JOIN PERSON PRS ON P.PARTY_ID = PRS.PARTY_ID WHERE LOWER(UL.USER_LOGIN_ID) = LOWER(#{username})
